P2.authority: supplier choice, contract terms and forward purchases, inventory buffers, logistics routes and carriers, export shipment planning

P3.authority: compliance programs, contract and platform-rule changes, litigation strategy, regulatory engagement and lobbying positions, data-protection measures

P4.authority: security posture and alert levels, patching priorities, incident response readiness, vendor/third-party risk, staff awareness, AI-tool policy

P5.company: Kazakhstan-based freight forwarder (Almaty) running rail and truck routes China–Kazakhstan–Russia and to the Caspian/Middle Corridor; clients include European and Russian importers.
P5.authority: route and capacity planning, fuel and carrier contracts, compliance screening of cargo and clients, contingency plans, pricing of services
